summary: Fail. The code works, but D157 was put inside the previous decision, D156, instead of at the end of docs/decisions.md. `athena retry` now accepts a stale job. If its kept candidate merges cleanly onto the new tip, the merged tree is checked, replayed and verified again, then lands with no producer call. If it conflicts, a producer starts from the conflicted merge and its result is verified in full before anything lands. Landing still refuses content whose fingerprint differs from the one verified. I ran the targeted tests and all passed: the lifecycle, run, land, git, briefs, reading and CLI retry tests, plus the decisions test. I used the release profile because the shared debug build cache was stale and the debug run failed to compile. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test checks also passed. The help text, reader brief, README and CHANGELOG are correct, and only the 13 listed files changed. D157 itself has the right content, and the diff is additions only. But it went in after line 4309, ahead of the last two lines of D156's Provenance bullet. Those lines now sit at the end of D157, so D156 loses its 'Not measured' sentence and D157 gains an unrelated one about D08. That fails criterion 6 ('appended at the end') and changes an existing decision's meaning, which the append-only rule is meant to stop. The pinned-prefix test only covers D121 and earlier, so it doesn't catch this. The fix is to move D157 after the original last line of the file.
